value.rationale: Square-gap counts and their normalized root measures refine the natural square Frobenius question. An exact all-parameter count, infinite reciprocal-threshold phase diagram with explicit nonzero derivative jumps, and a uniform parabolic root law in the growing-width regime yield a coherent classification not supplied by merely computing the largest gap. No claim of significance beyond this natural numerical-semigroup invariant is needed.
